newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU cuts refund on wheat flour exports - ONIC.
newsitem.headline: EU cuts refund on wheat flour exports - ONIC.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday cut the daily refund on exports of soft wheat flour to eight Ecus per tonne from a previous level of 24 Ecus per tonne, France's grain office ONIC said.
Last Thursday the EU's grain panel set the refund on soft wheat flour exports at 24 Ecus per tonne.
Earlier today the daily refund was brought down to 15 Ecus per tonne before being cut to eight Ecus, ONIC specified.
EU trade firms bidding in France had applied on Wednesday to export 60,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour under licences carrying a 24 Ecus per tonne refund.
Grain industry sources said the refund cuts were aimed at deterring flour exports while the Commission is closed for business between Christmas and the New Year.
